title: QuEra Unveils Gigaquop-Class Fault-Tolerant Roadmap and Launches FTQC Founders Circle
summary: QuEra gigaquop FT roadmap: post-Libra >1,000 logical / >20,000 physical qubits, ~1e-9 logical error, near-50% qLDPC encoding, tricycle magic-state codes, BB-STAR simulation architecture, NVIDIA real-time decoding (2028-2029). Flagship benchmark = FT simulation of the 8x8 transverse-field Ising model (the project's exact spin model). Launches the FTQC Founders Circle co-design program.
actionable: FTQC Founders Circle = concrete co-design outreach hook; extends the live HW-064 QuEra inquiry (thread 19ed11650e5ed845). Does NOT change near-term analog (HYP-017-class) feasibility; FT digital is 2028+.
